inside.title: Your whole weekend, one thumb
inside.blurb: Illustrations of the real screens, drawn to match. The schedule you build is the schedule you see — no feeds, no algorithm, no pull-to-refresh roulette.

items.title: Import any schedule
items.body: Drop in an .ics file or paste a Sched link. Re-import later without losing what you've picked.

items.title: Smart reminders
items.body: Nudges before the events you choose. Nothing else, ever.

items.title: Content flags
items.body: 18+ and photosensitivity warnings surfaced automatically from the schedule.

items.title: Works offline
items.body: Everything lives on your phone. Con WiFi dying at peak hours is someone else's problem now.

items.title: Download
items.body: Free on iOS and Android at launch.

items.title: Pick your convention
items.body: Import its schedule, or start one from scratch.

items.title: Build your weekend
items.body: Star what you want. Get nudged before it starts.

items.a: Yes. The schedule, imports, reminders, and offline mode are free. A ConPaws+ upgrade with extras is planned later — nothing you see here moves behind it.
No. ConPaws works entirely without one. Your schedule lives on your phone, not on our servers.

items.q: What if the con WiFi dies?
items.a: Nothing happens. ConPaws is offline-first: every feature keeps working with zero bars in a basement dealers' den.

items.q: Which conventions does it work with?
items.a: Any that publish an `.ics` calendar or a [Sched](https://sched.com) page — which covers most furry cons. You can also build a schedule by hand for the ones that don't.
The beta opens to the waitlist first, iOS and Android together. Join above and you'll get one email when your invite is ready.
ConPaws is built by [MrDemonWolf, Inc.](https://www.mrdemonwolf.com) — con-goers building the app we wished we had in the hallway line.
